ios.desc:
STOP LYING TO YOUR CALENDAR.

To-do lists feel infinite. If you have ADHD, lists are just a source of anxiety. You keep adding tasks, but reality keeps disagreeing. You schedule 10 pounds of work into a 5-pound day, and then feel guilty when you don’t finish.

DayZen: Visual Time Planner transforms your daily schedule from a stressful list into a logical 24-hour visual clock. Tasks become colored arcs. When the circle fills, it’s full. No more pretending a 3-hour project fits into a 30-minute gap.

It is the ADHD planner that finally works. Design your time. See your visual schedule. Find your focus.

WHAT’S NEW IN VERSION 2.0

We’ve rebuilt DayZen to be the ultimate time management companion for the neurodivergent mind.

- Live Activities & Dynamic Island: Track your active focus time, remaining duration, and progress without unlocking your phone.
- Immersive Focus Mode: A full-screen focus timer designed to eliminate ADHD distractions, complete with haptic feedback.
- Deep Insights: Analyze your time usage patterns with new interactive charts for daily, weekly, and yearly trends.

WHY THIS IS THE ULTIMATE ADHD PLANNER

For the ADHD brain, time is abstract. DayZen makes time concrete.

CONQUER ADHD TIME BLINDNESS

Don't just read your schedule: see your time. DayZen acts as a visual timer and planner to fix time blindness. Drag and drop tasks onto the clock face and resize them with a finger. Conflicts glow red instantly so you can fix your daily routine before the day starts.

INTUITIVE TIME BLOCKING

Forget rigid spreadsheets that kill dopamine. Simply drag a slice of time to create a task. It’s the fastest, most tactile way to build a daily schedule using the time blocking method.

STAY ON TRACK WITH WIDGETS

Keep your visual day at a glance. Our beautiful Home Screen widgets show your current time block and what’s coming next to prevent executive dysfunction.

SYNC WITH REALITY

Seamlessly integrates with your Apple Calendar. Your meetings, classes, and time blocks live in one unified visual circle.

BUILD BETTER HABITS

Set recurring tasks once (e.g., "Morning Meds" or "Deep Work") and let DayZen protect that time forever.

WHO IS DAYZEN FOR?

-Adult ADHD & Neurodivergent Minds: If you struggle with time blindness, focus, or maintaining a routine, this is the ADHD tool you’ve been waiting for.
-Visual Thinkers: For those who are allergic to endless text-based task lists.

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I've struggled with time-blindness my whole life. ADHD means I can write 14 tasks on a to-do list and genuinely believe I'll finish them before lunch. Reality disagrees at 11 PM when everything falls apart.

DayZen is my solution: your day as a 24-hour radial clock. Tasks become colored arcs. When the circle fills up, it's full. No more lying to yourself about what actually fits.

Just shipped 1.4 with Focus Mode
The new version adds features I've wanted since day one:

Focus Mode: Full-screen timer that zooms into your current task. Distractions fade, simple controls keep you on track. Built it because I kept checking my phone to see "what's next" and losing 15 minutes to Reddit.

Live Activities + Dynamic Island: Your active focus session shows on Lock Screen with time remaining and progress bar. Sounds simple, but it's been genuinely game-changing for staying aware without pulling out my phone.

Insights: Added analytics (today/weekly/monthly/yearly) with streaks and category breakdowns. Turns out I spend 40% of my time on "Important but not urgent" which explains a lot.

Time awareness improvements: Specifically designed for ADHD time blindness. Visual feedback makes abstract time concrete.

Why a radial clock?
Linear lists hide the finite nature of your day. They feel infinite, so you keep adding tasks. A circle forces honesty. Conflicts glow red immediately. You see gaps. You make the hard choices before the day starts, not at midnight when you're burned …
